name: HIPAA Security Rule
scopeNote: The HIPAA Security Rule is largely administrative and physical. SAST provides direct evidence only for the Technical Safeguards (§164.312) and supporting evidence for risk analysis/evaluation. Administrative and physical standards are marked not-assessable and require policy, training, and facility evidence.

controls.title: Risk Analysis
controls.summary: Conduct an accurate and thorough assessment of potential risks and vulnerabilities to the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of ePHI.
implementationChecklist: Identify vulnerabilities affecting systems that handle ePHI

controls.title: Risk Management
controls.summary: Implement security measures sufficient to reduce risks and vulnerabilities to a reasonable and appropriate level.
implementationChecklist: Remediate identified vulnerabilities to reduce risk

controls.title: Information System Activity Review
controls.summary: Regularly review records of information system activity such as audit logs and access reports.
implementationChecklist: Log and review system activity without leaking ePHI
evidenceExamples: Insufficient logging / sensitive data in logs findings

controls.title: Assigned Security Responsibility
controls.summary: Identify the security official responsible for developing and implementing security policies and procedures.

controls.title: Workforce Security
controls.summary: Ensure workforce members have appropriate access to ePHI and prevent unauthorized access.

controls.title: Information Access Management
controls.summary: Implement policies for authorizing access to ePHI consistent with minimum necessary.

controls.title: Security Awareness and Training
controls.summary: Implement a security awareness and training program for all workforce members.

controls.title: Security Incident Procedures
controls.summary: Identify, respond to, and document security incidents and their outcomes.

controls.title: Contingency Plan
controls.summary: Establish data backup, disaster recovery, and emergency-mode operation plans.

controls.title: Evaluation
controls.summary: Perform periodic technical and non-technical evaluation of security controls.

controls.title: Business Associate Contracts
controls.summary: Obtain satisfactory assurances that business associates safeguard ePHI.

controls.title: Facility Access Controls
controls.summary: Limit physical access to facilities and equipment housing ePHI.

controls.title: Workstation Security
controls.summary: Implement physical safeguards for workstations that access ePHI.

controls.title: Device and Media Controls
controls.summary: Govern receipt, removal, and disposal of hardware and media containing ePHI.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.summary: Implement technical policies and procedures that allow only authorized persons or software to access ePHI (unique user ID, emergency access, automatic logoff, encryption).

controls.title: Audit Controls
controls.summary: Implement mechanisms that record and examine activity in systems that contain or use ePHI.
implementationChecklist: Log access to ePHI without leaking it
evidenceExamples: Insufficient logging / sensitive data in logs findings

controls.title: Integrity
controls.summary: Protect ePHI from improper alteration or destruction.
implementationChecklist: Verify integrity of data and updates

controls.title: Person or Entity Authentication
controls.summary: Verify that a person or entity seeking access to ePHI is who they claim to be.

controls.title: Transmission Security
controls.summary: Guard against unauthorized access to ePHI transmitted over an electronic network (integrity controls and encryption).

controls.title: Policies, Procedures, and Documentation
controls.summary: Maintain reasonable and appropriate policies, procedures, and documentation of security measures.
